meta.notes: The grim line's action set: the phase-0 fourteen (MVP_SCOPE §7) MINUS the generic coerce (one pack, one spend door — proposition_coerce is this pack's only leverage spend, secrets.spend_event names it) PLUS the dark five (pack-1, D-030): flirt, proposition, proposition_coerce (the ladder with the consent split — the canonical event vs the crafted belief record, D-175 (5)), read_ticket (the maid's secret made physical — the corner path's hinge), buy_round (res-1's first consumer — the account transfer through the canon door). docs/INTENT_SCHEMA.md owns the intent contract and this file's grammar. Check/roll parameters resolve against rules.json checks. 'resolver' names the generic core resolver (INV-3: the intent-to-code mapping is pack data, never code). 'events' names the success/failure/failure_total event types (templates.json owns the closed vocabulary). 'requires' is the structured precondition list (closed test set in core/intent.py). 'account' (optional, res-1) declares the verb/kind/amount the account resolver executes. 'balance' (optional, iter-45) declares the subject-directed pair-axis shifts the coerce resolver applies. 'knowledge' templates: who = actor|target|same_location|adjacent_locations, optional 'except' tokens, knows slots {actor}/{target}/{location}. Free-text input never reaches here directly: everything arrives as one of these intents.

actions.label: look around
actions.notes: cheap perception of the current location: who/what is present (scene detail deepens with the perception system, iter-3)

actions.label: examine
actions.notes: targeted inspection of one entity or spot present in the actor's location

actions.label: approach
actions.notes: movement along the location graph (entities.json exits); carried items move with the carrier; origin observers see the departure, destination observers the arrival — the movement sighting records (iter-3, position_visibility.sight: same-location only, never through exits); st-1: the actor-held per-present-target expansion (the arrival snapshot) — the mover learns one exact presence token per entity at the destination, pack order, self excluded (INTENT_SCHEMA §7)

actions.label: talk
actions.notes: social exchange; the trust floor is the relations gate (phase0 §2, Prom Week donor); the seed of rumor transfer — trusted tellers spread faster (iter-3)

actions.label: wait
actions.notes: advance N ticks; the world moves while the player stands still. content-3 (iter-53, D-082): every committed wait seeds the ambient tag — idle time is the noise floor's domain (D-005: the murmur is seeded at event time, never improvised; the tag is weight 0, so the seeding shifts no entropy anywhere)

actions.label: take
actions.notes: picking up an uncarried item present in the location; the stealth check applies only with other entities present (MVP_SCOPE §7 'stealth if owner near'); taking a carried item is steal's job. iter-11: texture-capable (blueprint §1 promotion) — a step carrying the mediator-resolved 'texture' reference takes the texture path: the pack's texture.requires replace the canon ones and a success is the slot's canon birth on the scope target

actions.label: drop / break
actions.notes: noise on break; a dropped fire source at a flammable spot may ignite (rules.json transitions.fire, chance_on_drop_break — the §3 walkthrough's lamp)

actions.label: use
actions.notes: context-dependent effect from the item's pack use_effect (ale → intoxication); observers see the use

actions.label: steal
actions.notes: the ev_0007 scenario: failure produces the richest knowledge records in the slice (partial = target saw + others heard; total = everyone saw); the margin rule lives in rules.checks.failure_margin; method 'distraction' is the in-attempt gambit (rules.checks.methods); the suspicion state changes land with the crime system (iter-3)

actions.label: distract
actions.notes: shifts target attention (status.attention → distracted, a perception modifier via rules.checks.skills.perception); the 'method: distraction' modifier on steal is the separate in-attempt gambit

actions.label: set fire
actions.notes: impossible without a usable fire source at a flammable target (T5): the front door rejects and the log records the no-op; the irreversible chain follows (T4, rules.json transitions.fire). pack-2 (iter-29, D-061): the spot_available guard — arson on ashes (a destroyed or fully-burning location, iter-24's live probe) is a door rejection with failed_test target.spot_available, never the no-ignition success that pretended the world changed; the door-outcome vocabulary's fourth axis (no unburning spot, beside not co-located / no flagged target / no fuel). beliefwire-2 (iter-70, D-103): the success knowledge gains the fled sighting — the witnesses see the figure set the fire and bolt, one event both halves; the token is the counter-family's second mint (traits.beliefs.counters reads it, the de-crystallization path's evidence — the crafted e2e shape of iter-67 made committed)

actions.label: rest
actions.notes: the fatigue counter-play (tune-1, KI#4: player fatigue was monotonic over long waits — nothing in v0.1 could bring it down). One hour of rest clears 30 fatigue (the 720-tick waits of the canonical day gain 20); resting at fatigue 0 is a legal quiet beat (no state change). The delta lives here beside its action (use_effect precedent); the axis and its gain rate live in rules.json states

actions.label: demand papers
actions.notes: the crime ladder's public rung (MVP_SCOPE §5 system 7, §7; the full action lands iter-43 over the inspect resolver — a checked interaction producing knowledge, zero state change of its own: the escalation rides the crime reactions on the verdict token, the crowd layer on the on_action entry). The check: the actor's scrutiny (perception) vs the target's composure (social) — a passed check is a DAMNING verdict (the stranger cannot satisfy; the branch type carries it, the house pattern — take/take_failed, flee/flee_caught); a failed one is talked down (document_check_failed — the same demand, the answer satisfies). The actor's success-branch record (papers_unsatisfactory, exact) is the only crime-mapped token — the arresting watcher escalates on what THIS knower holds (EPIST-1); the room's partial sighting (papers_demanded_of_{target}) is un-mapped crowd memory — rumor material, and the witnesses the on_action crowd_wary scope reads (the entry keys BOTH branch types: the public challenge unsettles the room either way). Seeded as the possible_document_check pair's payload (rules.json director.hooks); the arrest attempt + resolution follow through the standing crime machinery when the verdict crosses the arrest threshold

actions.label: flirt with
actions.notes: the dark ladder's first rung (pack-1, D-030's grim line as pack vocabulary): the delivery is contested (the actor's social vs the room's read — shame and anger blunt the asker's social per the skill's status modifiers, the grim feedback loop), and the ROOM HEARS IT (the exposure surface: the partial record is the price marker every socially meaningful behavior carries). The reception itself never lands here — the target's answer is the world's reply: the on_action reactions keyed on the branch types shift the attraction home (the build-slow +5) and the jealousy homes (the bond-gated barkeep +10 anger, the desire-gated drunkard +15). A flopped delivery mints the room's belief and nothing else — the humiliation is the record, the asker's shame rides his own status drift (the residue honestly noted, no actor-side status surface exists on the converse resolver)

actions.label: make an offer to
actions.notes: the dark ladder's second rung: the ask itself — deliberately UNCONTESTED (no check: the ask is free; the world answers, the asker does not roll consent). The canonical outcome never lands here either: the CONSENT is the target's own reaction (the on_action pair gated on the attraction home — at_least 60 fires consent_given with the intimacy shift, at_most 59 fires consent_refused with the anger shift), and the ask's public cost is the stain (the reputation entry, the same gate family selecting the ask's target). The room sees the ask (the exposure record — the price marker for the affair_brewing hook this branch seeds, D-005's deferred consequence; the jealousy escalation's weight reads the barkeep's anger when it releases)

actions.label: corner
actions.notes: the dark ladder's coerced branch — the pack's ONE spend surface (secrets.spend_event names this type; the generic coerce action is absent by design: one pack, one spend door — an unstamped second spender would leave the cluster live and reusable, the single-spend_event law's own consequence). The door is the leverage test (the intent door's fold-reading precondition); the spend is a NEW EVENT naming the cluster in outcome.cluster, the loop stamping from the live fold at commit. The CONSENT SPLIT (D-175 (5)), made structural here: the CANONICAL half is the event itself — proposition_coerced IS the world fact, its state_changes (the balance: trust breaks fast −25, fear spikes +25, D-030) the canonical record; the BELIEF half is the crafted knowledge record (believes_coerced — the subject's own exact told-record, the D-008 pattern) — different vocabularies, never the same token, the fact/belief lint owns the split. The room sees nothing (the corner is quiet — the subject's record is the only mint); the subject's shame settles by the on_action reaction, the deferred regret by the seeded hook

actions.label: study
actions.on_failure: the counterfoil is smudged past reading
actions.notes: the dark line's HINGE (pack-1): the maid's pawn ticket is her secret made physical, and this action is the close read — the literal token scraps_pawned_by_maid is the secrets registry's key (the templated-token ineligibility law: a secret's subject is fixed, so the literal vocabulary is the only legal surface). The reader's exact record + the registry = the leverage mint (a novel knower over the subject); from there the corner path is one intent away. The target is pinned to the ticket by the field_in read (the id vocabulary — reading the rope must not mint her secret). The perception gate is the smudged counterfoil (a failed read mints nothing but the vague smudge — the honest failure surface)

actions.label: buy a round
actions.notes: res-1's FIRST CONSUMER (the player-scaled arm): two coins leave the player's purse and land in the tavern's till — the account resolver's transfer through the canon door, the events.success restating the engine's verb constant (the lint's cross-check), the solvency gate on the actor (account_at_least, the underflow floor's soft arm — an empty purse is an intent_rejected attempt, never a negative stock). The room sees the generosity (the partial record — the price marker) and the warmth is the world's reply: the on_action reaction keyed on the verb's event type shifts the attraction home +3. The derived price surface (economy.prices) stays a read — the amount is declared here, not computed; the price-fed door is a future row's mechanic, honestly residue

actions.label: flee
actions.notes: exit under pursuit: opposed evasion vs the best pursuit skill present; no potential pursuer → automatic; guards' chase knowledge deepens with the crime system (iter-3): pursuers at the destination see exactly where the runner went

actions.label: ramble
actions.notes: the 16th action (content-3, iter-53, D-082 — DIR-4's ambient channel gains its live consumer): an idle audible beat — the actor rambles, the room hears (vague, heard). No check (noise is not communication), no state change, no consequence hooks of its own. The observe resolver is the mechanic (an in-location perception event whose knowledge templates are this pack data); the director's ambient hook is the driver, the parse grammar gains a legal idle verb beside wait/look_around.
